entries.0dbdb100640645f8: This single-segment business provides a gateway service that connects multiple cashless payment providers with merchants and offers all cashless payment services on a one-stop basis, together with the sale of payment terminals and related development work. It consists of the company, two consolidated subsidiaries (Webspace Co., Ltd. and For J Co., Ltd.) and one equity-method affiliate (Jii Shii Kikaku Co., Ltd.). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,276 million. The customers accounting for 10% or more of revenue are Nihon Card Network Co., Ltd. (¥1,505 million) and Sumitomo Mitsui Card Company, Limited (¥1,403 million).
